# Paid Search Account Audit

`paid-search-account-audit` · v1.0.0 · Diagnose · Paid Media & Budgeting
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/paid-search-account-audit/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Where is our paid search account wasting spend, and which campaign should get more budget?

**Inputs:** Your target cost per conversion; nine setup checks (conversion tracking verified, CRM outcomes imported, brand separated, and so on); per campaign, type, spend, clicks, impressions, conversions, bid strategy and impression share lost to budget and rank; the search terms report with spend, clicks, conversions and whether each is a keyword; regex patterns for terms that can never convert for you; and per landing page, spend, clicks, conversions, message match and mobile usability

**Output:** Account, brand and non-brand CPA; the share of spend in campaigns and terms that produced nothing; every campaign's findings (no conversions, starved winner, far over target, thin automated bidding); the terms to negate and the winners to add as keywords; the pages that do not convert or do not match the ad; a single fix list ranked blocking-first then by spend; and a verdict - foundations, waste, scale, fix or healthy

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill paid-search-account-audit`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/paid-search-account-audit/resources/search-audit.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/paid-search-account-audit/resources/search-audit.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: not recorded yet.

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- It judges the account only against the target CPA you give it. Without one it cannot name a starved winner or a campaign far over target.
- It cannot see the account. Setup items marked unknown count as not done, and unverified conversion tracking makes the verdict 'foundations'.
- Ten clicks before negating, 30 conversions for automated bidding and 20% impression share lost to budget are this engine's rules, not benchmarks.
- It reads one export period of attributed conversions. It cannot tell whether brand search spend is incremental; use incrementality-and-mmm for that.

**Review before acting:** Whoever runs the account verifies conversion tracking and the nine setup items in the platform, and the founder or finance lead confirms the target CPA, before negatives are added or budget is moved.
